name: Delta
source:
He possesses an emotionless and practical mindset, projecting an impersonal demeanor towards all around him. His only interest is in his research, and he considers Kurumi, as a human, to be his most fascinating subject yet. Intent on studying her emotions, he frequently makes sexual advances towards her, merely to gauge her reaction.

(Taken from eroderekko)
